title: One Discounted Edge
statement:
Use Dijkstra on two states per vertex. A route may replace at most one edge cost w by floor(w/2).

Input
n m q s, then m directed edges u v w, then q target vertex IDs.

Output
Print the minimum cost to each target, or −1 if unreachable.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 200000. Endpoints are in [1,n]. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. 0 ≤ w ≤ 10⁹.
